basic_info.description: This charming and move-in ready Visitacion Valley home with views has potential inside and out, and is a blank canvas ready for the finishing touch to be put on by new owners! On a quiet street with plenty of parking, this home is seamlessly close to transportation and freeways, making San Francisco and the Peninsula equally accessible.  Driveway and garage parking ensures plenty of space for multiple vehicles, and downstairs basement and storage spaces provide ample opportunity for further use, including a possible additional bedroom and bathroom. The upstairs living space exits out to a spacious view-centric deck, with south and east facing views including the bay, with a sizable yard beyond it. Solar panels on the roof take advantage of the plentiful sunshine. Come and take this home across the finish line!
